{{Quote|Diablo Cut! No one's ever done it before&hellip; probably for the good reason that it's impossible&hellip;!|[[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="SW17">[[Star Wars (1977) 17|''Star Wars'' (1977) 17]]</ref>}}
The '''Diablo Cut''' was a treacherous portion of [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], notable for its allure to daredevil [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].

==History==
Just before leaving for the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] and his [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] friends held a celebration and one last race through the canyon. The race ended in battle, however, when a group of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] attacked. When Darklighter was injured by a [[Gaderffii/Legends|gaderffii]] stick, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was forced to pilot him to safety with his [[Skyhopper/Legends|skyhopper]] through Diablo Cut.<ref name="SW17" />
